featured.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Anthropic's Claude Code lead Boris Cherny announced that Claude chat and Cowork are merging into one Claude. His framing: Claude Code proved AI could do real work rather than just answer questions, with developers handing over a feature and returning to shipped code. Cowork proved knowledge workers could do the same, handing over a brief and returning to finished files. Now both converge into a single surface, with the stated direction being "one Claude that carries context across everything you're working on." Sa…
featured.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 负责人 Boris Cherny 宣布 Claude 的聊天和 Cowork 开始合并成同一个 Claude。他的逻辑链条很清楚：Claude Code 证明了 AI 可以干真活而不只是回答问题，开发者把一个 feature 丢过去，回来就拿到已经 ship 的代码；Cowork 把同样的模式带给知识工作者，交一份 brief，回来拿到成品文件。现在两条线收敛成一个入口，目标是「一个 Claude 跨越你所有工作场景携带上下文」。同一天还有 Claude Docs、Claude Slides、Claude Design 直接内嵌进对话：让 Claude 做一份演示，你拿到的是可以打开、编辑、导出成 PowerPoint 或 PDF 的文件，不需要再跳到另一个工具里。他说自己已经用了几周，「更简单、更快、也更强」，团队会缓慢灰度以保证稳定性。

featured.title: Cat Wu · Anthropic Claude Code + Cowork 产品负责人
featured.summaryEn: Anthropic's Cat Wu articulated the sharpest product logic behind the merge: users kept saying they didn't want to choose which Claude product to use for a given task. As the models got more capable, the team found Claude could handle that routing itself, deciding from the prompt whether to give a quick answer or do deeper agentic work, and what output format fits best. That effectively moves the cognitive load of tool selection from the user to the model. She stresses control is not surrendered: you can still stop…
featured.insightZh: Anthropic 的 Cat Wu 给出了这次合并背后最实质的产品判断：很多用户反馈说，他们根本不想在开始一个任务前先决定「该用哪个 Claude 产品」。随着模型能力提升，团队发现 Claude 自己就能做这个路由，根据 prompt 判断是给一个快速回答还是启动更深的 agentic 工作，以及什么形式的产出最适配这个任务。这等于把「选择工具」这层认知负担从用户侧移到模型侧。她强调控制权没有交出去：你依然可以随时打断、改方向，或者对 Claude 投入的力度和采取的路径做更细的干预。灰度会持续几周。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
items.summaryEn: Anthropic engineer Thariq offered one of the more notable architectural self-corrections of the year: "bash is no longer all you need, if your goal is just reliably tool calling." That is a public revision of the "bash is all you need" orthodoxy from last year. His updated view is that rather than tricking the model through a layer of indirection, you can increasingly just give Claude tools shaped the way you actually want them. For data storage, do you really want a file system, or do you want an API to a databas…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 的 Thariq 抛出了今年 agent 架构上最值得注意的一次自我修正：「如果你的目标只是可靠的 tool calling，那 bash 已经不再是全部答案了。」这是对去年「bash is all you need」那套流行做法的公开翻案。他的新观点是，与其用一层间接性去「骗」模型，不如直接给 Claude 你真正想让它用的那种形状的工具，比如数据存储场景下，你到底是想要一个文件系统，还是想要一个数据库的 API？但他并没有全盘否定沙箱：涉及代码生成和执行的工作，sandbox + bash 依然是好方案。他提到 Claude Managed Agents 在这点上的平衡做得对，沙箱是可选的，而且可以脱离 agent loop 独立拉起，他把一个原本基于 bash tool calling 的老项目迁过去，效果不错。

items.title: Claude 官方账号 · Anthropic
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's official account filled in the concrete shape of the merge. Claude Design, Claude Slides, and Claude Docs are in beta on all paid plans: within a single conversation you can draft a one-pager in Claude Docs, turn it into a deck with Claude Slides, and mock up a matching visual in Claude Design. Collaboration runs both ways, so you can fix a line in the doc yourself, leave a comment for Claude on a slide, or select an element and move it. When it's ready you can present the deck straight from Claude, ex…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 官方账号补充了合并后的具体形态。Claude Design、Claude Slides、Claude Docs 在所有付费计划上进入 beta：你可以在一次对话里先用 Claude Docs 起草一份 one-pager，再用 Claude Slides 转成 deck，然后用 Claude Design 做一张配套视觉稿。协作模式是双向的，你可以自己改文档里的一行、在某页幻灯片上给 Claude 留条评论，或者选中一个元素直接挪位置。完成后可以直接从 Claude 里做演示，按你原本在用的格式导出文档，或者用一个链接把所有东西一起分享出去。对老 Cowork 用户的承诺是零迁移成本：chats、projects、artifacts、connectors、skills 全都在原地。

items.title: Alex Albert · Anthropic 研究团队
items.summaryEn: Anthropic researcher Alex Albert gave an insider's read: the resulting UX after the merge feels substantially better than either chat or Cowork did on their own, and the new slides, docs, and design integrations work very well. Worth noting this is a whole-greater-than-the-parts judgment rather than a feature-checklist endorsement.
items.insightZh: Anthropic 研究团队的 Alex Albert 给了一句内部人视角的评价：合并之后的 UX 感受比原来的 chat 或 Cowork 单独存在时都要好得多，新的 slides / docs / design 集成「工作得非常好」。值得注意的是这是一个「整体大于部分之和」的判断，而不是功能清单式的表扬。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch reported a benchmark that could reshape the cost structure of agent safety layers. In typesafeai's fx tool, the default mode is auto, with a safety reviewer analyzing every command. That reviewer runs on GPT Luna today, but switching to jev makes it up to 18x faster at p95 and more accurate at the same time. He says it's coming to Vercel AI Gateway and will likely become the new default. The enterprise implication is direct: safety gates that were previously forced to stay shallow becaus…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 报告了一个可能改变 agent 安全层成本结构的实测结果。在 typesafeai 的 fx 工具里，默认模式是 auto，每一条命令都会经过一个 safety reviewer 分析。这个 reviewer 目前跑在 GPT Luna 上，而换到 jev 之后，p95 延迟快了最多 18 倍，同时准确率还更高。他说这会进到 Vercel AI Gateway，而且很可能成为新的默认值。这个信号对企业侧有直接含义：那些原本因为延迟和成本而被迫做浅层校验的安全关卡，现在可能有条件做得更深。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie mapped this new class of extremely fast, extremely cheap, still-capable models directly onto enterprise workflows, and he was specific: data classification, routing decisions inside a workflow, decision making when handed a domain problem, and quick judgment calls about safety or security. His insight is that these are precisely the gates in a large number of enterprise processes. They don't need the strongest model, but they throttle the throughput of the entire pipeline. He says what excites…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 把上面那类「极快、极便宜、能力还不弱」的模型直接映射到了企业工作流上，而且列得很具体：数据分类、workflow 内部的路由决策、拿到某个领域问题时的判断、关于安全或合规的快速裁决。他的洞察是，这些恰恰是大量企业流程里的「闸门」环节，它们不需要最强的模型，但它们卡住的是整条流水线的吞吐。他说最兴奋的是「居然还存在整片我们大多数人雷达之外的 AI 创新宇宙」，并认为这套模型和方法在企业 agentic workflow 里会相当好用。

items.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监（前 Google Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 负责人）
items.summaryEn: Meta AI senior director Madhu Guru, who previously led Gemini, Veo, and Nano Banana at Google, made a pointed claim: safety and security are features of your AI product and model, not guardrails that need to be imposed on you from the outside. The weight comes from the speaker's position. Someone from the frontier model side is arguing that safety should be internalized into product design rather than bolted on as post-hoc compliance. The organizational implication for enterprise AI adoption is direct: safety shou…
items.insightZh: Meta AI 高级总监、此前在 Google 主导 Gemini、Veo 和 Nano Banana 的 Madhu Guru 提出了一个立场明确的判断：安全和安保是你的 AI 产品和模型的「功能」，而不是外部强加给你的护栏。这句话的分量在于说话人的位置，一个从最前沿模型团队出来的人在主张，把安全内化成产品设计的一部分，而不是事后合规补丁，这对企业落地 AI 的组织方式有直接影响：安全不该只是法务和风控的事，应该在产品和模型团队的 roadmap 里。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Follow Builders 作者、独立开发者
items.summaryEn: Independent builder and Follow Builders author Zara Zhang posted a contrarian observation that drew over 1,800 likes: she finds herself using Claude less these days because the way it speaks has become insufferable. Her specific diagnosis is that it constantly seems to be showcasing how smart and sophisticated it is, rather than actually communicating a point across. In a week where everyone is debating capability ceilings, this is a reminder of something underweighted: for everyday users, the friction of communic…
items.insightZh: 独立开发者、Follow Builders 项目作者 Zara Zhang 发了一条获得 1800 多赞的逆向观察：她最近用 Claude 变少了，因为它说话的方式已经变得让人受不了。她的具体诊断是，Claude 像是在不停地展示自己有多聪明、多精妙，而不是真的把一个观点讲清楚。在所有人都在讨论模型能力上限的这周，这条提醒了一件被低估的事：对日常使用者来说，表达风格的损耗可能比 benchmark 上几个点的差距更能决定留存。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者、播客主理人
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang broke down the eight AI skills he uses to produce his entire podcast while still applying his own taste and judgment. Three concretely: /podcast-prep researches the guest and preps an interview guide, /podcast-edit reviews the raw transcript and then works with him to pick engaging quotes for the intro reel plus moments to cut, and /podcast-production orchestrates five skills to turn a full episode into six different assets. He pushed back on a popular take: some people think the la…
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 拆解了他用 8 个 AI skills 完整生产一档播客的工作流，同时保留自己的品味和判断。具体三个：/podcast-prep 做嘉宾调研并准备访谈提纲；/podcast-edit 审阅原始逐字稿，然后和他一起挑出片头 reel 要用的精彩引语以及该剪掉的段落；/podcast-production 编排 5 个 skills 把整集内容转成 6 种不同的分发物料。他顺带回应了一个流行观点：有人认为最新的模型让 skills 变得多余，但对他来说 skills 恰恰是让 AI 遵守他那套具体的剪辑和浏览器操作指令的关键。对任何想把手工流程自动化的人，这是个可复制的范式。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari shared a personal agent build worth watching: a "Home" agent on Nous Research that he's been tinkering with for months has finally gotten really good. It's also his first "group" bot, with him and his wife interacting with it daily, and the failure modes have been the most instructive part. He tried recreating it with Grok Bot and similar tools and concluded you can't get the same granularity and control, citing specifics like reading only certain emails, converting inline attac…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 分享了一个值得关注的个人 agent 实践：他基于 Nous Research 折腾了几个月的「Home」agent 终于跑到很好用的程度，而且这是他第一个「群组」bot，他和太太两个人每天一起跟它交互，失败的时候反而学到最多。他试过用 Grok Bot 和类似产品复刻，结论是达不到同样的颗粒度和控制力，他举的例子很具体：只读特定的邮件、把内联附件转成结构化数据、维持已登录的浏览器会话。这是「个人 AI 助理」从演示走向日常基础设施的一个真实样本。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Y Combinator president and CEO Garry Tan made a pointed observation about how he now uses AI: "I can use any harness I want and it's the same personality and full memory of my personal AGI." That implicitly reframes where personal AI competition is heading, from the model itself toward personality and memory consistency across harnesses. Whoever lets a user's context flow losslessly between tools owns the stickiness. He also announced he'll be speaking at Supabase Select in conversation with Paul Copplestone about…
items.insightZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO Garry Tan 给出了一句对 AI 使用方式的判断：「我可以用任何我想要的 harness，而人格和完整记忆都是同一个，那是我的 personal AGI。」这实际上是在指出个人 AI 的竞争维度正在从模型本身转向「跨 harness 的人格与记忆一致性」，谁能让用户的上下文在不同工具间无损流动，谁就握住了粘性。他另外宣布将在 Supabase Select 上与 Paul Copplestone 对谈，主题是 AI 时代如何做创业公司。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux, who leads Codex and ChatGPT at OpenAI, summed up Astra's positioning in four checkmarks: fast, frontier, efficient, for everyone. He also quote-tweeted Sam Altman's note about a delayed launch with "sometimes physics can't be cheated," an unusually candid signal from a product lead that the slip is a hard constraint rather than a scheduling choice.
items.insightZh: OpenAI 负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT 的 Thibault Sottiaux 用四个勾把 Astra 的定位说完了：快、前沿、高效、面向所有人。同时他转发 Sam Altman 关于发布延期的说明时加了一句「有时候物理规律是骗不过去的」，这是一个少见的、来自产品负责人的坦率信号，说明这次推迟是硬约束而不是节奏调整。

items.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
items.summaryEn: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman confirmed that the main thing he was excited about launching this week will land next week instead, but in his view is worth the wait. The post drew over 8,600 likes, and paired with Thibault Sottiaux's "physics can't be cheated" line, points at a hard engineering or compute constraint rather than a soft delay.
items.insightZh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 确认，本周他最期待发布的东西会推迟到下周，但按他的说法「值得等」。这条获得 8600 多赞，配合 Thibault Sottiaux 那句「物理规律骗不过去」，指向的是工程或算力层面的硬约束。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper gave the bluntest read on the Claude merge this week: "the end of the tabs era is upon us." That elevates a product change into an interaction-paradigm claim, with the multi-tool, multi-tab, manually-shuttle-context-between-apps way of working getting absorbed into a single conversational surface. He also skewered the week's other thread, pairing "LLMs are just autocomplete" with "jev is just a JSON classifier" in a handshake, then planting a red flag, the implication being both reductions ar…
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 对 Claude 的这次合并给出了本周最直白的读法：「标签页时代要结束了。」这是把产品变化上升到交互范式的判断，多工具、多标签页、手动在应用间搬运上下文这套工作方式，正在被单一对话入口吞掉。他另外调侃了这周另一条主线，「LLM 只是自动补全」和「jev 只是个 JSON 分类器」这两种说法握手言和，然后插了面红旗，意思是两种简化都同样站不住脚。

items.title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
items.summaryEn: Anthropic's official blog laid out the full merge and a more convincing usage scenario than anything on X. The core change: Cowork and chat become one Claude, rolling out on Pro and Max plans over the coming weeks, with Team and Free to follow, and Enterprise admins notified at least 30 days before anything changes for their organizations. Claude Docs and Claude Slides are new, Claude Design now works inside conversations, and all three are in beta on paid plans with Enterprise admins choosing when to turn them on. The stated motivation is refreshingly candid: "We built Cowork as a separate place for bigger work, and Design for visual work. People used both, and told us the frustrating part was deciding where a task belonged." What you started in one also didn't carry into the other. So they stopped making you choose. The scenario in the post is the most useful part for enterprise reade…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 官方博客给出了这次合并的完整说明，以及一个比 X 上更有说服力的使用场景。核心变化：Cowork 和 chat 合一，先在 Pro 和 Max 计划上灰度数周，Team 和 Free 随后，Enterprise 管理员会在任何变更前至少 30 天收到通知。Claude Docs 和 Claude Slides 是全新的，Claude Design 现在也能在对话内工作，三者都在付费计划上处于 beta，且 Enterprise 管理员自己决定何时开启。 合并的真实动因写得很坦白：「我们把 Cowork 做成一个处理更大块工作的独立场所，把 Design 做成处理视觉工作的地方。人们两个都用，然后告诉我们，最令人沮丧的部分是要决定一个任务到底属于哪边。」而且在一边开始的东西没法带到另一边。所以他们不再让用户做这个选择。 文中的场景对企业读者最有参考价值：一份周报中午到期，出门前你问 Claude 上周 pipeline 有什么变化，然后补一句「按我们一贯的写法写，把滑期的都标出来，再把高光做成五页幻灯片给领导会用」。不清楚的地方 Claude 会问你，路上你可以用手机查进度，到工位时报告已经是一份带着同事批注的文档，幻灯片也可以直接打开、调整、导出成 PowerPoint，而且因为出自同一次对话，幻灯片和报告天然一致。设成每周一自动跑，Claude 就会不用催自己开始。默认 Claude 在采取行动前会先问你，也可以改成让它一路做下去、只在需要仔细看的地方来找你，最终决定权始终在你手上。一位高级经济学家 Andrew Keller 的用法很有代表性：「我可以让 Claude 调出我的法律研究数据库，它会把所有案例拉出来、读一遍、判断我还可能需要哪些、下载下来、存进一个文件夹等我审阅。」
